selection_rule.call_policy: record actual arguments at BL, then invalidate r0-r3
selection_rule.runtime_conflict_policy: different selected palette bytes or non-unique ROM source leave the record unresolved
selection_rule.runtime_oam_rule: scan every tracked .ss9 in lexical order; require the full graphics payload at its statically proven OBJ VRAM destination, an active hardware OAM object whose 4bpp tile range intersects it, one consistent attr2 palette bank, and one unique exact 32-byte ROM palette source
selection_rule.sources: all literal_load_users of the 20 source-inventory graphics records
selection_rule.unresolved_rule: no accepted static palette operation and no accepted runtime OAM binding

synthetic_index_palette.purpose: diagnostic index visibility only; not a ROM palette
